verdict.rationale: All evidence shows Hyperbrowser exposing its own capabilities via an MCP server for other AI clients to consume (hyperbrowser-docs-8, hyperbrowser-gh-1, hyperbrowser-probe-rt-1), not Hyperbrowser itself acting as an MCP client that can import external MCP servers' tools into its own agent (HyperAgent/page.ai). No evidence describes configuring third-party MCP servers for Hyperbrowser's agent to call.
